_comment: llm-se-bench MCP servers. Drop this into your client's config:
Claude Code: .mcp.json in the project root
Replace /absolute/path/to/llm-se-bench with your checkout. cwd matters:
the servers resolve data/, results/ and the cache database relative to it.
Verify before wiring it up: python -m mcp_servers --self-test
LLM_SE_BENCH_BUDGET_EUR is the safe default. Without it, run_benchmark
refuses every non-dry run rather than guessing a ceiling.
